title: MIRAGE: Misleading Retrieval-Augmented Generation via Black-box and Query-agnostic Poisoning Attacks
reasoning: The paper focuses on developing and evaluating a poisoning attack pipeline to introduce misinformation into RAG systems. While this has ethical implications regarding the spread of false information, it does not involve benchmarking or evaluating LLMs on ethical reasoning, morals, or faith as a core component of its methodology or research questions.
